description: Make a Swiss QR-bill (QR-Rechnung, SIX Swiss Payment Code SPC 0200, structured addresses as required since November 2025) as a print-ready PDF: receipt and payment part with the 46 mm Swiss QR code and Swiss cross, on A4 or as the 210 x 105 mm part alone, in German, French, Italian or English. Checked before the bill is drawn: CH / LI IBAN (mod-97), QR-IBAN with its 27-digit QR reference (mod-10 recursive), RF creditor reference (ISO 11649) with a normal IBAN, CHF or EUR, amount, address lengths, country code and character set. Returns the PDF (base64) and the validated payload line by line. Deterministic, 0 AI, nothing stored. Free: 5 calls/day per IP. Paid: Radar API key (from €15/mo at https://radarbg.com/pricing#starter via X-API-Key) or $0.005/call via x402 at https://radarbg.com/x402/swiss-qr-bill.

amount.description: Amount, 0.01 to 999999999.99. Leave it out for a bill where the payer writes the amount

creditorCountry.description: Creditor: 2-letter country code; default is the country of the IBAN

creditorHouseNo.description: Creditor: building number, up to 16 characters (optional)

creditorName.description: Creditor: name of the account holder, up to 70 characters

creditorPostalCode.description: Creditor: postal code, up to 16 characters

creditorStreet.description: Creditor: street, up to 70 characters; a house number at the end is split off when creditorHouseNo is empty

debtorCountry.description: Debtor: 2-letter country code; default is the creditor's country

debtorHouseNo.description: Debtor: building number, up to 16 characters

debtorName.description: Debtor (optional, leave all debtor fields out for an empty box): name, up to 70 characters

debtorPostalCode.description: Debtor: postal code, up to 16 characters

iban.description: IBAN or QR-IBAN of the creditor (CH or LI, 21 characters); spaces are fine

language.description: Language of the headings on the bill

layout.description: a4 = A4 page with the payment part at the bottom, slip = the 210 x 105 mm payment part with receipt alone

message.description: Additional information for the payer, up to 140 characters (for example the invoice number)

qrPng.description: Also return the Swiss QR code alone as PNG (base64) for your own invoice layout

reference.description: QR reference (27 digits, needed with a QR-IBAN) or RF creditor reference (ISO 11649, only with a normal IBAN). Leave it out for a bill without a reference

name: swiss_qr_bill
title: Swiss QR-Bill API - QR-Rechnung PDF with IBAN, QR reference and address checks
